name: Save Card - Utility User
purpose: Saves the Utility User card: commits and calls Create User in karbon_kontroller with the UtilityUser JSON. Shows "This User was not created." on error, otherwise closes the card.
writes: none (the User is created by script 500)
external: Perform Script in another file: karbon_kontroller (step 4)

name: Button: Create Party From User
purpose: Button on the Utility User card that opens the Create Party card for an employee person under the system owner organization, with a timer that picks up the new person.
open_question: $params starts unset, so only the four JSON keys listed are sent.

name: OnTimer: Handle Create Party From User
purpose: Timer handler that links the User to the person created in the Create Party card: clears the timer, and if a person id exists in UtilityParty, writes it to User::PartyId and commits.

name: Dev: Clear Party ID for User
purpose: Developer helper that clears User::PartyId on the current User and commits. Effect owner would be client-ui.

name: Dev: Clear Party ID for System
purpose: Developer helper that clears System::OwnerId (the owner party of the system) and commits. Effect owner would be client-ui.

name: Utility User - Search for Duplicate People
purpose: Searches for duplicate people when creating a User: calls Get Party in karbon_kontroller with the first and last name (person only). If the result is an error (none found) it saves the User; otherwise puts the matching party id list in selector::PartyListId and shows the "Duplicate People Found" object.
external: Perform Script in another file: karbon_kontroller (step 13)
open_question: Search options are inconsistent: $SearchPerWord is passed but never set ($FullWordSearch is set and unused), and NumberOfDigitsPerWord is 12 while the comment suggests 3. The name-matching rules live in Get Party (script 186).

name: Utility User - Select Existing Party
purpose: Picks one of the duplicate parties: stores the selected party id in the UtilityUser record, commits and saves the card (creating the User linked to that existing party).

name: Utility User - No Matches
purpose: Records that no duplicate matches were chosen (NoMatchesInd = 1), commits and saves the Utility User card.

name: Utility User - Handle Create
purpose: Create handler on the Utility User card: when the user is not a person, saves directly; otherwise requires first and last name (error dialog) and runs the duplicate people search.
